<details class="glossary-card">
<summary>Glossary &amp; further reading <span class="glossary-hint">· optional</span></summary>

Reflection
:   Examining how evidence and experience changed your reasoning, and what you would do differently next time. Here, connect your initial view to a specific model result or sensitivity finding.

Transfer of learning
:   Applying a method learned in one setting to a different problem. The inputs-to-recommendation pattern can support another investment decision, with assumptions adapted to that case.

Assumption
:   An input or condition accepted for modelling purposes that may still need verification. A calculation based on it does not turn it into verified evidence.

Qualified recommendation
:   Advice that states the conditions or uncertainties affecting it, such as verifying self-consumption before committing. It supports a decision without claiming that approval or verification has already occurred.

::: glossary-reading
